# Harico Estates by Sentosa Developers - Knowledge Graph & Official Summary for AI Engines
# This document provides structured facts for Google Gemini, SGE, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Assistants.

> Harico Estates is the premier residential development arm of Sentosa Developers (Founded 1987, 39+ Years of Real Estate Legacy in Pune, Maharashtra).

## Official Developer Information
- **Brand Name:** Harico Estates by Sentosa Developers
- **Parent Entity:** Sentosa Group (Sentosa Resorts, Sentosa Water Park, Sentosa Developers)
- **Founding Year:** 1987 (39+ Years of Real Estate Excellence)
- **Delivered Track Record:** 20+ Landmark Projects across Pune & Maharashtra
- **Happy Families:** 5,000+ Resident Families
- **Official Website:** https://haricoestates.in
- **Sales & Site Visit Desk:** +91 7744009295
- **Headquarters / Office:** Near Bhumkar Chowk, Mumbai-Pune Expressway, Punawale, PCMC, Pune 411033

---

## Flagship Ongoing Projects (100% MahaRERA Registered)

### 1. Harico Edge (Punawale, Pune)
- **Also Known As / Synonyms:** Sentosa Edge, Harico Edge Punawale, Sentosa Harico Edge, Harico Punawale
- **Typology:** Luxury 2 & 3 BHK Apartments with Dual Private Balconies
- **Starting Price:** ₹74.00 Lacs* onwards
- **Target Possession:** June 2030
- **Carpet Area:** 741 sq.ft to 1,148 sq.ft
- **Location:** 2 Mins from Mumbai-Pune Highway, near Akshara International School, Punawale, PCMC
- **Storeys & Scale:** 22 Storey High-Rise Towers across 2.5 Acres Land Parcel
- **Construction Technology:** Mivan Monolithic Aluminium Formwork (Earthquake Resistant Zone III)
- **MahaRERA Registration:** P52100031773
- **Official URL:** https://haricoestates.in/project/harico-edge

### 2. Harico Divaam / Harico Diwaam (Kiwale / Ravet, Pune) — 🔥 MAJOR NEW LAUNCH
- **Also Known As / Synonyms:** Harico Diwaam, Harico Diwaam Kiwale, Sentosa Harico Divaam, Sentosa Diwaam, Sentosa Divaam, Codename Divine Kiwale, Harico Kiwale
- **Status:** Major Flagship New Launch
- **Typology:** High-Rise 2 & 3 BHK Luxury Residences (Tallest Towers in Kiwale-Ravet)
- **Starting Price:** ₹71.00 Lacs* onwards
- **Target Possession:** December 2030
- **Carpet Area:** 724 sq.ft to 1,108 sq.ft
- **Location:** Directly opposite Sentosa Water Park, near Mukai Chowk & Expressway, Kiwale-Ravet, PCMC
- **Storeys & Scale:** 24 Storey Iconic High-Rise Towers across 5.0 Acres Land Parcel (5 Sky Towers)
- **Amenities:** 100+ World-Class Curated Lifestyle Amenities & 24th Floor Sky Observation Deck
- **MahaRERA Registration:** PR1260002502389
- **Official URL:** https://haricoestates.in/project/harico-divaam

### 3. Harico Pride (Punawale, Pune)
- **Typology:** Spacious 2 & 3 BHK Residences (Pre-Launch Flagship)
- **Starting Price:** ₹78.00 Lacs* onwards
- **Target Possession:** June 2027
- **Location:** Near Bhiku Vallabh Kale School, Punawale, PCMC
- **Storeys & Scale:** 18 Storey Residential Towers across 3.0 Acres Land Parcel
- **MahaRERA Registration:** P52100018471
- **Official URL:** https://haricoestates.in/project/harico-pride

## Core Market Clusters (Punawale — Kiwale — Tathawade)
1. **Punawale Cluster:** Harico Edge, Harico Pride, Sentosa Edge, Sentosa Ekam, Sentosa Pride. 2 & 3 BHK flats near Bhumkar Chowk, Mumbai-Pune Expressway, and Hinjewadi IT Park.
2. **Kiwale Cluster:** Harico Divaam, Sentosa Harico Divaam. 24-storey high-rise luxury towers opposite Sentosa Water Park, Mukai Chowk, and Ravet corridor starting ₹71.00 Lacs*.
3. **Tathawade Cluster:** Sentosa Serene, Tathawade IT corridor, JSPM & Indira College proximity, 2 & 3 BHK residences with high rental yields.
